snippet.title: Toy Story 5 Buzz Lightyear Game & Go | Demo Video | VTech Toys®
snippet.description:
Play five learning games featuring the voice of Disney & Pixar Buzz Lightyear and explore letters, numbers, shapes and more with Buzz and his Toy Story friends. Blast letter balloons to get a message from Woody, count toy horses, choose shapes to help build Bonnie’s toy house, solve logic problems to play the Claw and dodge obstacles to rescue Jessie and Bullseye. Kids can also meet their favorite characters through toy-riffic animations. You might be the greatest learner in the galaxy! 

Intended for ages 3+ years. Requires 3 AAA batteries.
